description: This file defines the class 'HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_Tidy_Proprietary', which extends 'HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_Tidy'. It sets the name and default level of the module, and provides a method 'makeFixes' that creates attribute transformation rules for background attributes in various table-related HTML elements.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_Tidy_Proprietary
classes.description: A class representing a proprietary Tidy module extension for the HTMLPurifier library, specializing in handling background attributes for table elements.

methods.name: makeFixes
methods.description: Creates and returns an array of attribute transformation objects for background attributes on table-related HTML elements.
